messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up 1: we have a pricing experiment (price-sheet v4) that introduces a new tier structure. Product wants a 'legacy shield' so existing customers keep their current monthly credits for 180 days. How do we operationalize on invoices + avoid accounting noise?
Evan Brooks: Can we make shielded credits a distinct invoice line called "Legacy Shield Credit" and have a unique credit_code for reconciliation? That helps bookkeeping.
Sofia Martinez: Agree. We should also include a promo_id in the invoice meta so exports/reports can filter. Example CSV row: 
```
customer_id,invoice_id,credit_code,promo_id,amount,notes
C-9001,inv-2026-06-01,LSHIELD-180,PSV4-2026-05,-150,legacy_shield_applied
```
Jared Kim: Important: reserved customers with committed discounts must not double-dip. My proposal: apply committed_discount first, then apply shield credit up to remaining outstanding balance. No negative invoices.
billing-bot: recon-scan: sample run on 200 accounts in "legacy" cohort -> predicted disputes=2, predicted net-revenue-impact=-$6,800. See /recon/report/2034.
Sofia Martinez: Also need proration rule if a shield is applied mid-billing-cycle. I suggest prorate credit by days remaining, and store prorate_factor in invoice metadata.
Maya Chen: Good. What about vendor pass-through? If shield reduces billable usage, vendors who bill based on usage will expect an adjustment.
Vendor Ops: pinged vendor ops privately. Quick note: some vendors require a separate offset entry on their invoices. If we reduce customer-facing bill, we must send vendor adjustments. That is extra reconciliation work.
Evan Brooks: Then we should avoid automatically reducing pass-through unless vendor agrees. Default: shield only offsets Redwood's line items. If vendor opt-in flag true -> adjust pass-through.
Jared Kim: For A/B test tracking: we'll run a 5% canary in cohort A (shielded) vs cohort B (no shield). Need unique experiment_id on invoices: EXP-PSV4-2026-05.
Sofia Martinez: I'll add SQL to tag accounts. SQL: `UPDATE customers SET price_experiment='PSV4-2026-05', shielded=TRUE WHERE signup_date < '2025-12-31' AND account_tier='standard';`
Maya Chen: Approvers needed: Sofia (Billing Lead), Evan (Revenue Ops), Vendor Ops rep. FinOps Approvals: can you confirm by EOD? Also need rollback plan: revert price-sheet and issue reversal credits with code "LSHIELD-REVOKE".
FinOps Approvals: Need timeline and gating metrics. Propose canary 2026-06-07 (5% of eligible), monitor 7 days. Gate rules: disputes > 0.4% OR chargeback_count > 3 -> auto-hold.
billing-bot: alert-configured: monitor metrics: disputed_invoices_count, chargebacks_last_7d, net_revenue_delta_pct. will post daily digest.
Evan Brooks: Also, add a reconciliation job to produce a mapping file: `shield_audit_<date>.csv` with columns: customer_id,invoice_id,original_credit_amount,applied_credit_amount,prorate_factor,experiment_id.
Sofia Martinez: I'll write the small ops runbook and sample gh PR for the price-sheet change. PR will include invoice schema bump and export field names.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. @Vendor Ops please confirm vendor opt-in status by 5pm PST. If no veto, we proceed with canary next Friday. :rocket:
